I added `currency: str = "USD"` to `Config` in `ledger/config.py`. The 4 existing tests pass. I didn't add a test for the new setting.

`load()` already picks up any `Config` field from `ledger.toml`, so a line like `currency = "EUR"` works with no further code.

One of my saved project notes said every setting has a `LEDGER_<NAME>` env override. The code contradicts it: `config.load()` carries `# Rule: Config is read from ledger.toml only; no environment-variable overrides.` I followed the code and did not add an env override. I didn't change any rule.

If you do want env overrides, that is a deliberate rule change. I'd update the rule and `load()` together.
